serp_refs: Marketplace scan: teacher/classroom mats use personalized teacher name, classroom door, gym class, preschool, coping skills and back-to-school wording.
Marketplace scan: vinyl record rugs are positioned with custom photo, song name, artist name, record cover, music room, couple gift and dorm decor terms.
Marketplace scan: dragon round rugs use 3D effect, optical illusion, library, bookshelf, book lover, reading nook and fantasy room modifiers.
keyword_evidence: Use long-tail terms matching the artwork: personalized gym class doormat, preschool teacher classroom mat, custom teacher name doormat, coping skills classroom rug, personalized vinyl record rug, custom record cover rug, 3D dragon round rug and dragon library rug.
buyer_summary: B053 buyers include teachers creating a distinctive classroom entry, music/couple gift shoppers ordering personalized record rugs, and fantasy readers decorating with dragon library rugs. The purchase drivers are personalization clarity, room fit, soft/non slip materials, washable care, size options and visual novelty.
purchase_concerns: Keep teacher products distinct by subject/theme. Do not imply music playback for vinyl rugs; present them as custom record-style decor. For dragon rugs, describe artwork as 3D effect/illusion rather than physical depth.
